'''Croym''' was an extremely powerful [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who was in possession of the [[Heart of the Universe]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He enticed three groups of individuals to his base of operations, a dark tower located on a barren [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], and forced them to compete in order to find a suitable [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] student.
